f.name: Star Gold Casino & Hotel
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | Star Gold is a licensed casino but also rents online office space. The company that owns the casino is a major property developer with several other projects in the vicinity where space is also leased to online operators. Past and present directors include individuals in provincial government and law enforcement positions.…

f.name: Sand Palace Hotel / Aurora Hotel

f.name: Puli Casino
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | In December 2023, nine Thai nationals reportedly escaped from Puli Casino and told border guards they had been forced to work there as scammers. In 2025, a Thai police investigation identified a scam operation of up to 100 people operating from Puli. It was also raided in 2019 on suspicion it was housing illegal online gambling.…

f.name: Poipet Resort & Casino / Grand Residences
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | Linked to a fugitive former Thai government official, the Poipet Resort & Casino’s old site housed online operations but was destroyed in a fire in 2022. This new location offers office space for rent, with recruitment ads found online for high commission paying jobs in customer service, live streamers, and social media account managers.…

f.name: Poipet Palace Plus Casino
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | Poipet Palace Plus operates a land-based casino, and PPP branded gambling websites can also be found online. It also rents out space to online operators. It had its casino licence suspended in 2025.…

f.name: Baolong 3 Park / Sanco Special Economic Zone
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | Baolong 3 is a large scam compound situated within the Sanco Special Economic Zone. It has featured regularly in various Telegram channels used by scam industry insiders, and in April 2026 was the site of a major raid in which gunfire was exchanged as hundreds of workers attempted to flee.…

f.name: KAEC Poipet Casino (New Site) / Jinhai Park
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | In 2025, KAEC Casino moved to this new location from a smaller property in the centre of Poipet. Construction of the compound began in 2024, and within a year the site reportedly had more than 500 people working in online scam operations. The site goes by the name Jinhai Park in Chinese. It is connected to a government adviser who holds the rank of undersecretary of state.…

f.name: O’Neang International Casino / Qilin Park
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | O’Neang International Casino sits at the centre of a wider complex of buildings hosting online scam operations. The casino licence covers multiple buildings far beyond the actual casino building, and is held by a company owned by a military official.…

f.name: Navy 3 / Lucky Building
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | This location appears in online posts advertising space for rent through 2025. f.name: KMH Paradise Tower Casino Hotel / KMH 2

In May 2026 it was raided by the police, who found evidence of online scams. Soon after, its casino licence was revoked.…

f.name: Crown Resorts Poipet
f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | Online scam and gambling operations have been reported at Crown Casino properties since at least 2016. Ads recruiting online workers can be found on social media and job websites. Several deaths have been reported at various Crown buildings, and Thai authorities have investigated human trafficking cases linked to the complex. In 2025, Thai police issued warrants for the Cambodian owner and several family members, raiding their properties in Thailand and seizing millions of dollars in assets. In 2026, the owner was sanctioned by the United States for alleged links to online scams.…

f.listing_excerpt: Cambodia | Baolong 4 developed rapidly from the start of 2024, quickly becoming one of the largest scam compounds in Cambodia. Violence and deaths have been reported at the site. The site was evacuated after authorities began to crack down on online scam sites in Poipet April 2026.…

In January 2026 thousands of workers fled the site and as of February it was closed. It is reportedly owned by a now arrested Cambodian tycoon.…
